hooks.name: aidlc-session-start
hooks.description: Starts an AIDLC session: notes the session opened and gives the assistant the current workflow context.

action.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\aidlc\aidlc-shim.ps1" engine adapter kiro-ide session-start
